column1: # Historical release → commit map, used only by .github/workflows/release.yml
# to place BACKFILLED tags at the commit that shipped each version.
# Releases stopped being cut after v0.5 while the plugin kept shipping (the
# manifest reached 0.15.2). This file pins every documented CHANGELOG version
# between the v0.5 tag and now to the last commit that carried that version,
# so the one-time backfill tags each release at its real historical commit
# The workflow only reads this for versions that have no release yet, so once a
# version is released the row is inert. New versions do NOT need a row here —
# the workflow tags them at the merge commit that bumped the manifest. This
# file is a frozen record of pre-automation history; leave it as-is.
